brief.t: First move: send Drake at True Revival his quote. Luke and Nikkie have asked three plus times since Monday. Quote Q zero zero two seven is already drafted in the CRM at six thirty three sell per unit. Send the two thousand unit pricing now, five thousand tier follows.
Two calls today: Michael Lohan at ten AM, and the EPHIX Ryan TMF Venture Fund meeting at four PM eastern.

Victor Armendarez numbers are due today, his deadline. I'm building the cost model this morning. Warning: the CRM has zero packaging and labor data, so I'm using benchmarked assumptions you sanity check before it goes out.
Sky and Sol follow up and Talova samples to Marcello are both due today.
Ben Kar proposal went overdue Wednesday. I draft it today, you fire it once by email and WhatsApp, then we park him.

Aidan has six overdue tasks including Atlas, Pure Good, and Drake's matcha quote, and hasn't answered my Sunday message. I'm on him this morning. Also Ronald says Aran Beauty samples are blocked, no formulation brief exists in the CRM.

Good news: Maqui Berry client delivered feedback on all products overnight, so Ronald and Evelyn are unblocked. Dev side: production blank screen closed, deals pipeline ready notice still pending, and Sam, your corrected raw material prices are still outstanding.

next: One lane: send Drake the True Revival quote. Nothing else first.
Review Victor's numbers I hand you by noon, send before end of day.
Sky and Sol plus Talova samples, then the four PM EPHIX meeting. Ben Kar proposal review last.

kb.a: Drake Militello at True Revival is the angriest thread. Luke and Nikkie have asked three plus times for the quote promised Monday. Quote Q zero zero two seven is drafted at four fifty two cost, six thirty three sell per unit but was never sent. Sam sends the two thousand unit pricing today, five thousand tier and Japanese matcha sourcing answer to follow.

Victor Armendarez, eighty seven percent close, two thousand units per SKU of Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel, six ounce jars, turnkey. His numbers are due today, Friday. The agent is building the cost model with benchmarked packaging and labor assumptions because the CRM has none. Sam reviews and sends before end of day.

Elmar Nasibov clarified he wants formula price only, no packaging. Serum is a thirty mil treatment pump. Three products: hydrating mist, peptide cream, hydrating serum. He nudged again last night. The agent is computing formula pricing at sixty five percent margin from Ronald's costing today.

Ben Kar of Tavro, roughly thirty thousand units custom tallow and argan oil, ninety percent close, proposal task went overdue Wednesday. The agent drafts the full proposal today. Sam sends it once by email and WhatsApp, then we stop chasing.
Michael Lohan call today at ten AM eastern, from the July eighth daily briefing.

EPHIX meeting with Ryan of TMF Venture Fund today four to five PM eastern, confirmed in Outlook. Also the law firm asked whether to proceed filing the certificate of assumed name for EPHIX, Sam or Aidan needs to reply.
Sky and Sol follow up is due today. The sample already went out and the client is back from vacation tomorrow, Saturday July eleventh.
Talova samples to Marcello are due today per the CRM task.

Aidan has six overdue tasks: Atlas quote to Kenna and Pure Good pricing both due July eighth, Drake's matcha quote July ninth, Morning Glory shampoo quote July seventh, MEN STUFF quantity from June ninth, and Hassell shipping from June twenty fifth. He also hasn't answered the agent's July sixth status message. Being pushed this morning.

Ronald replied Wednesday: Aran Beauty scent samples are blocked because no formulation brief exists in the CRM. He also delivered the full ASSEA cold shipping writeup. Maqui Berry feedback arrived overnight so he and Evelyn are unblocked for reformulation. Still open: jojoba substitute, Smoke Oak and Iron Pine fragrances, dish detergent.
Maqui Berry is unblocked. Ryani delivered feedback on all products overnight in the WhatsApp group. Ronald and Evelyn can start reformulation now.

Aran Beauty wants vanilla, jasmine, rose, and sweet orange scent samples, but Ronald says the lab cannot batch them because no formulation brief exists in the CRM. Sam or Kenna must supply the base formula first, then the client gets a timeline on WhatsApp.
Zayed at Minalone has asked four plus times since late June for Nick's packaging quote and is being forced out of his manufacturer's space. He needs an answer today and an owner assigned.

Kenna gatekeeps everything Pure Good including quote Q zero zero two eight, roughly three hundred twenty nine thousand dollars, and Atlas Skin at thirty four thousand three hundred. Aidan's Atlas and Pure Good pricing tasks are two days overdue. If Kenna stalls, that's Sam's relationship to push.

Terra Lotus expanded: thirty thousand units of face cleanser in tubes plus shampoo, conditioner, and body wash samples at two hundred mil each. Aidan's quote task still needs updating to include the cleanser and samples.

Deals pipeline migration is in development. The dashboard already shows ten active deals worth about one point three seven million dollars, but the developer has not sent the ready for verification notice yet. The agent verifies the full board the moment it lands, then populates all real deals.

Ticket status: production blank screen fixed, verified and closed. Formula ingredient upload fix is deployed but stays open until Evelyn's next real upload proves it, likely the Flex Cosmetics formula today. Laura's access issue awaits her fresh login. Raw materials fallback is closable, but Sam still owes the corrected raw material prices.

Oreka quote Q zero zero zero seven is accepted. Pending Sam's go ahead: log the eighty five fifty five payment, open the production job for one thousand peptide creams, delete the orphan formula, and fold in Nikkie's commission.
Nicolas Massri, new from the July eighth briefing. Hospitality opportunity, five thousand to one hundred thousand units. Unqualified but big. Briefing says call as soon as possible.
Flex Cosmetics samples are due today. The honey ingredient blocker has an agreed workaround. Evelyn's formula upload for Flex doubles as the live test of the formula upload bug fix.
James Bailey, Morning Glory. Laura sent him a revised estimate marked high importance, awaiting his signature. Aidan's related shampoo quote task is three days overdue.
Tiffany, hot lead, flying to Africa soon. James is handling and told her the proposal takes time. She sent her cost of goods. Make sure a call is booked before she travels.

ASSEA: Ronald delivered the full cold shipping writeup for refrigerated samples, which needs to be relayed to Apostolia. Still open: the NDA she is waiting on, Laura preparing, and the HS code documents.
Kristen Reed, about ten thousand dollar intro deal, baby safe skin barrier spray. Laura is point for scope and R and D quote, task creation pending.
Kyle at AloeTallow: Sam said done but never confirmed the outcome. Was the refund averted or charged? Still needs Sam's confirmation.
The three one two number lead wants to license a PLL formula with different scents and colors. Unanswered since July third. The agent is replying today to qualify volume, product type, and timeline.

Laura sent the revised James Bailey estimate, is handling Raul's box design mockup, and asked for three things internally: printer ink, production scheduling for Roon, and a turn down letter draft. Her CRM access fix awaits her fresh login.
Raul at STRUCK, existing client. HRIPT submission from the July briefing at seventy five percent. Laura is handling his box design mockup.
New facility lease closed, move imminent. Move checklist draft is on the agent's desk, Sam reviews before anything goes live.
Sam still needs to rotate the shared Gmail password. Two minutes. Not optional.
Dashboard this morning: one point three seven million pipeline across ten active deals, seventeen jobs in production, fifty thousand five hundred in deposits, sixty seven customers.
